# Module Objectives

At the end of this module, you should be able to:

- manage and analyze temporal variables with `lubridate`;
- study the relationship between two variables using graphs and descriptive statistics;
- calculate and interpret a correlation between two numerical variables;
- write a short exploratory analysis report while distinguishing association from causation.

# Readings

Before the adventure, review the following resources:

- [R for Data Science - Exploratory data analysis](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/EDA.html){target="_blank"}
- [R for Data Science - Dates and times](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/datetimes.html){target="_blank"}
- [R for Data Science - Data visualization](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/data-visualize.html){target="_blank"}
- [R for Data Science - Missing values](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/missing-values.html){target="_blank"}
- [Introduction to Modern Statistics - Exploring numerical data](https://openintrostat.github.io/ims/explore-numerical){target="_blank"}
- [Introduction to Modern Statistics - Applications: Explore](https://openintrostat.github.io/ims/explore-applications){target="_blank"}

## Posit cheat sheets

- [Dates and times with lubridate :: Cheatsheet](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/lubridate.pdf){target="_blank"}
  Creating, extracting and manipulating dates and times.

- [Data visualization with ggplot2 :: Cheat Sheet](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/data-visualization.pdf){target="_blank"}
  Charts for comparing distributions, trends and associations.

After the readings, complete the [formative mini-test](mini_test.qmd). It is not graded; it only checks the basic ideas before the adventure.

# Adventure

[Adventure 5](aventure.qmd)

Follow the adventure to load `flights_merged_2023.rds`, create temporal variables and practise the requested exploratory analyses.

# Challenge

[Challenge 5](defi.qmd)

The challenge asks you to submit a `rapport.qmd` report and its rendered `rapport.html` version. The report must answer Sofia's three questions about time slots, weather and plane age.

# Consolidation Exercises

[Module 5 exercises](exercices.qmd)

The exercises are independent from the adventure and challenge. They use small fictitious datasets to consolidate technical skills:

1. prepare dates and times of day;
2. check missing values;
3. summarize groups while showing sample sizes;
4. calculate simple correlations;
5. visualize associations;
6. write descriptive and cautious conclusions.
